blocks.orig: After a wonderful day on mesmerizing Mafia Island, there is nothing better than to jump aboard a traditional dhow for an impressive Mafian sunset at sea. The dhow departs at 5:30 pm with a waiter and drinks on board, after which the captain gently sails you through Mafia’s aquamarine waters. Once he has found a spot to settle, he drops the anchor and you can raise your glass to a sky filled with striking red, pink, purple and orange just above an endless ocean. An amazing sight!
blocks.html: Following a lovely day on enchanting Mafia Island, nothing beats stepping aboard a traditional dhow to watch an impressive Mafian sunset out at sea. At 5:30 pm the dhow sets off with a waiter and drinks on board, and the captain sails you calmly across Mafia’s aquamarine waters. When he finds a good place to stop, the anchor goes down and you can toast a sky glowing in vivid red, pink, purple and orange above the never-ending ocean. A wonderful sight!
